title: Soft Color Blocking

sourceAuthority.publicationOwner: Vikrant Varun Kudesia — named human publication receiver

purpose.plainLanguage: An approachable visual system for guided workflows, operational applications, diagrams, and review experiences with explicit state.
populations: Product and operations teams who inspect a shared workflow.
Reviewers who need explicit state and an approachable route into technical detail.
Cross-functional groups who point at a shared artifact and explain what fits or changes.
jobs: Group workflow steps or system regions into broad semantic fields.
Make selected, pending, held, accepted, error, and recovery state explicit.
Connect an inviting product grammar with inspectable technical relationships.

fits: Architecture diagrams that share a product visual grammar.
Context trees, impact maps, role boards, and route comparisons.
poorFits: Dense scientific instruments benefit from Industrial Ink.
Relationship-heavy system cartography benefits from Cobalt Operating Field.
Long-form narrative benefits from Rose Quartz or another reading-first field.
fit.smallestUsefulDose: One large semantic field, one strong label, square geometry, and one explicit state relationship.

invariants: Large flat fields group related work and preserve a visible hierarchy.
Square or near-square geometry creates the characteristic rhythm.
Written labels and state relationships carry meaning while color reinforces the distinction.
Solid offset layers create depth that remains inspectable in source and print.
Accepted work and recovery routes remain visible during failure.
permittedVariation: Field count, orientation, accent distribution, and domain vocabulary can follow the receiving workflow.
Authentic documentary imagery can keep source-native color inside a labeled figure.
Framework adapters can vary while state meaning, keyboard behavior, focus, and recovery stay stable.

uses: Cobalt text and boundaries on warm white.
Warm-white text on cobalt actions and structural fields.
Body text on blush orientation fields.

families: A rounded geometric system sans for display headings and major action labels.
A familiar system sans for body copy and native controls.
A system monospace for compact status, identifier, and route labels.
uses: Display type stays compact enough to preserve block relationships at narrow widths.
Metadata stays short and high-contrast and receives a 200 percent text-resize observation.

geometry.depth: Solid cobalt offsets and bordered fields create explicit, inspectable depth.
geometry.spacing: Broad fields and whitespace establish hierarchy before additional accents appear.

errorRecovery: Loading, stale, invalid, and error states preserve accepted content.
Recovery offers retry, restore accepted work, edit the draft, or contact the named owner according to local authority.
A held state names its responsible role and the evidence that can move the work forward.
behavior.focus: A high-contrast double ring remains visible across blush, paper, cobalt, chartreuse, coral, and forced-color fields.
behavior.keyboard: Native controls preserve tab order, grouped selection behavior, visible labels, and a polite selected-state announcement.
behavior.motion: Block or route emphasis can support changed-state continuity; reduced-motion mode presents the final arrangement directly.
behavior.noJavaScript: The main sequence, state labels, instructions, and semantic companion remain complete in document order.

media.reflow320CssPx: Broad fields stack in source order; a named local inspection region carries a genuinely two-dimensional graph.
media.textResize200Percent: Block height grows with content and labels wrap inside the field that owns them.
media.print: White paper, black text, retained borders, written states, and the evidence boundary create the print record.
media.forcedColors: Canvas, CanvasText, ButtonText, Highlight, and HighlightText carry field boundaries and selected state.
media.reducedMotion: Travel resolves to the final state while focus, selection, recovery, and accepted state stay visible.
media.svg: A useful title and description, semantic groups, written edge labels, stable IDs, and a nearby table carry the same reading.
media.imagery: Images receive a figure number, concise caption, source standing, and a full-size route when detail matters.

establishes: Established repository examples demonstrate broad field grouping, square geometry, explicit labels, and technical-diagram use.
Focused source tests validate schema shape, reference-token declaration, declared paths, and named contrast pairs.
boundaries: Each established example retains its local behavior and CSS authority.
Authorization, scientific validity, durable transactions, and operational receipts remain with the receiving application.
reentry: A palette, state-meaning, browser, accessibility, source-example, or authority change reopens review.
A receiving implementation that claims exact token parity earns a byte or value-level drift check.
